tier_should.rationale: Compelling randomized governance intervention with audited feedback and incentives improves efficiency and neonatal outcomes; addresses prior PBF failures. Credible identification and verified data, though bundle masks component effects; qualitative mechanisms. Strong contribution at intersection of development, health, and governance.

tier_will.rationale: Recognized authors, NBER WP, salient to donors and journals in development, health, and management. Robust RCT results on hard outcomes, but bundled design and measurement concerns may limit A-general appeal. Likely to land in top field outlet.
